test_title: PYST 05: SSC Stenographer 2025: English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 07 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Choose the correct direct speech form of the following sentence.

They requested the officer to permit them to go on leave for three days..

options.text: They said to the officer, "Please permit us going on leave by three days."
They said to the officer, "Please permit us to go on leave for three days
They said to the officer, "Please permit them to goes on leave for three days."
They said to the officer, "Request to permit us to go on leave for three days."

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Indirect Speech:** They requested the officer to permit them to go on leave for three days.
 
• **Key Conversions:**
 
 
• **"requested the officer to permit them" becomes "Please permit us"**
 
 
• The polite request "requested" is converted to "Please."
 
• Pronoun "them" is changed to "us" to match direct speech.
 
 
 
• **"to go on leave for three days" remains unchanged.**
 
 
• The phrase is kept intact as it directly conveys the action and duration.
 
 
 
 
 
• **Punctuation and Format:**
 
 
• Direct speech is enclosed in quotation marks.
 
• Starts with a capital letter "Please" and ends with a period ".".
 
• Reporting clause precedes the quoted speech.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"They said to the officer, 'Please permit us to go on leave for three days.'"*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** "Please permit us going on leave by three days."

 
 
• Incorrect phrasing: "going on leave by three days" is grammatically incorrect.
 
 
 
• **Option 3:** "Please permit them to goes on leave for three days."
 
 
• Incorrect pronoun: "them" should be "us."
 
• Incorrect verb: "goes" should be "go."
 
 
 
• **Option 4:** "Request to permit us to go on leave for three days."
 
 
• Incorrect phrasing: "Request to permit us" lacks the polite tone of direct speech.
